Three comments

The Redeside Hornpipe

A Will Atkinson of Alnwick tune.. To be honest I have forgotten where I first heard it ..so sorry I cannot refer to a recording But it will be one of the tapes he played with Joe Hutton and Willy Taylor. I was only reminded of it when I realised it ws not included in Dow’s list of Northumbrian tunes

↳ Posted by alexboydell on March 16th, 2006.

Redeside Hornpipe

Sorry two errors bar 5 change the B B to GB and bar 21 the final GF shold be G>F so both bars should read
|G>B, D>G B>A G>F |

↳ Posted by alexboydell on March 16th, 2006.
